gloss: to be thrilled; (of the heart) to leap

definitions.gloss: to be thrilled; one's heart leaps
definitions.explanation: To feel a lively, eager excitement, as at something one is looking forward to. Most often used before a noun: {心躍|こころおど}る〜, "exciting, thrilling".

examples.japanese: {心躍|こころおど}る⟦{冒険|ぼうけん}→冒険：03629_bouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}→海外旅行：24321_kaigairyokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{心躍|こころおど}る。
examples.english: My heart leaps at the thought of my first trip abroad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{出会|であ}い→出会い：03445_deai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{心躍|こころおど}る⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, days go by with my heart leaping in expectation of new encounters.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧ (heart) + ⟦{躍|おど}る→躍る：31959_odoru⟧ (to leap, to jump), so literally "the heart leaps". Also written ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{躍|おど}る→躍る：31959_odoru⟧, which is the same expression with the particle.

USAGE:
A somewhat literary word, common in advertising, book blurbs and travel writing. It is far more often used before a noun ({心躍|こころおど}る⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧, a thrilling experience) than as the main verb of a sentence.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦わくわくする→ワクワクする：25801_wakuwakusuru⟧: the everyday, conversational way to say one is excited
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{躍|おど}る→躍る：31959_odoru⟧: the same image with ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧ (chest); equally literary
